security_audit.summary: Most detections are documentation snippets, Firebase SDK method names, or Firebase documentation URLs and are false positives. Four setup commands are confirmed medium-risk external command guidance because they install or run latest npm packages and can change Firebase project state. No evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Firebase CLI setup commands use latest package resolution and automatic npx execution.
remediation.suggestion: Pin firebase-tools versions, remove automatic yes behavior where possible, and require explicit user approval before running npm or npx commands.

remediation.issue: Global Firebase CLI installation can change the user environment.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a project-local dev dependency or explain the global install impact before suggesting npm install -g.

content.value_statement: Developers often need Firebase AI features without maintaining a separate backend. This skill guides setup, Gemini model usage, multimodal prompts, structured output, and production security for web apps.
actual_capabilities: Guides Firebase AI Logic setup for web projects using the Firebase Web SDK.
Explains Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI Gemini API provider choices.
Shows text, chat, streaming, multimodal, image generation, and structured output patterns.
Covers App Check and Remote Config recommendations for production deployments.
References Firebase documentation and web usage patterns for implementation support.
limitations: Focused mainly on web examples; mobile and Flutter guidance is only summarized.
Does not provide a full application scaffold or deployed Firebase project.
Requires existing Firebase knowledge, account access, and billing decisions for production features.
Some setup commands install or run Firebase CLI packages from npm.

use_cases.title: Add Gemini text features
use_cases.description: A web developer can initialize Firebase AI Logic and call Gemini for text generation.

use_cases.title: Plan multimodal workflows
use_cases.description: A product engineer can map image, audio, video, and PDF inputs to Firebase AI Logic patterns.

use_cases.title: Prepare production controls
use_cases.description: A Firebase lead can review App Check, model configuration, and provider selection before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Set up Firebase AI Logic
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add Firebase AI Logic to a web app. Check prerequisites, explain provider choice, and list the safest setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add multimodal input
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through accepting an image file in a web app and sending it to Gemini with Firebase AI Logic.

prompt_templates.title: Stream chat responses
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a chat flow using startChat and streaming responses. Include state handling, loading states, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a production launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Firebase AI Logic launch plan. Focus on App Check, Remote Config model selection, quota protection, and billing risks.

output_examples.input: Set up Firebase AI Logic for a web prototype.
output: Setup sequence with user confirmation points.

output_examples.input: Plan a multimodal image caption feature.
output_examples.output: A workflow covering file handling, MIME type checks, Gemini prompt design, and response display considerations.

best_practices: Ask before running npm or Firebase CLI commands, especially global installs.
Enable Firebase App Check before exposing AI calls in production clients.
Use Remote Config for model names when teams need controlled updates.
anti_patterns: Running npx commands with automatic yes flags without user approval.
Hardcoding model versions across client releases without an update path.
Sending large files inline when Cloud Storage URLs are more appropriate.

faq.question: Does this skill create a Firebase project?
faq.answer: No. It explains setup steps and command options, but project creation still needs authorized user action.

faq.question: Which provider does it recommend by default?
faq.answer: It recommends Gemini Developer API by default and Vertex AI Gemini API when scale or enterprise requirements need it.

faq.question: Does it support mobile platforms?
faq.answer: It lists Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity, and web support, but the included usage patterns focus on web.

faq.question: Can it help with structured output?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes response schemas and JSON response handling for Firebase AI Logic.

faq.question: What security controls are covered?
faq.answer: It covers App Check for quota protection and Remote Config for safer model version updates.

faq.question: Are external commands required?
faq.answer: Some setup guidance uses npm and Firebase CLI commands. Users should review and approve them before execution.
